answers.core: It relates entirely to the engine's handling of the import suffixes, a plugin or addon would be possible and could be done as a tool etc, but again this feels like some Quality Of Life improvements that most anybody working in 3D would appreciate.
answers.workaround:
It could be worked around in an import script, which is my current plan to work on next, but these feel like universal headaches to anybody using the -colonly suffixes with the intention of parenting to their corresponding meshes. Since adding a static child is already the standard handling for -col suffixes, my suggestion only makes it the expectation consistent for the -colonly suffixes.

For those who don't want it reparented, simply don't name your -colonly objects the same as an object that already exists.

title: Match "-colonly" object names, and reparent StaticBodies to Matching MeshInstance parents
